meta.title: Pricing — KB Labs
meta.description: KB Labs is free today. Open-source core, no telemetry, no lock-in. Commercial layer coming later.

items.q: Is OSS Core really free forever?
items.a: Yes. Runtime, SDK, CLI and workflow engine — MIT + KBPL1.1. No freemium, no paywall, no future limits. We make money on Cloud hosting, enterprise support, and custom plugin development. Gating the core would break the whole model.

items.q: How is Cloud different from self-hosted?
items.a: Only the infrastructure. Same open engine, same capabilities. Cloud is for teams who want to ship today without thinking about updates, backups and monitoring.

items.q: What does Enterprise plugin development include?
items.a: We build plugins for your specific workflows. The plugins are your property, private by default. You can open-source them if you choose. We do not make private changes to the core — it evolves the same for everyone.

items.q: Is on-prem OSS the main scenario right now?
items.a: Yes. The current focus is early on-prem adoption with engineering teams. Cloud and enterprise tracks are being shaped together with early adopters.

items.q: Is this a no-code tool for business teams?
items.a: No. The platform is built for engineering teams who create and maintain plugins for their own processes. The CLI is the primary interface.
